goal: Review a software bill of materials (SBOM): whether it is complete, current and usable for vulnerability and…
use: Review a software bill of materials (SBOM): whether it is complete, current and usable for vulnerability and licence checks. Use when an SBOM is produced or asked for by a customer or audit.

steps.note: Read the SBOM. Open the SBOM file, its format (SPDX or CycloneDX) and the tool that made it.
Check completeness. Compare the SBOM with the lock files.
Check the identifiers. Each component needs a name, version and a package identifier (purl or CPE) so it can be matched to advisories.
Check currency. An SBOM must be produced for each release.
Check the licences. Note components with no licence recorded, for the licence check.
Report. List the gaps, with the component, the problem and the fix.

protocol.title: Read the SBOM
protocol.text: Open the SBOM file, its format (SPDX or CycloneDX) and the tool that made it.

protocol.title: Check completeness
protocol.text: Compare the SBOM with the lock files. Flag packages missing from it, including transitive ones.

protocol.title: Check the identifiers
protocol.text: Each component needs a name, version and a package identifier (purl or CPE) so it can be matched to advisories.

protocol.title: Check currency
protocol.text: An SBOM must be produced for each release. Flag an SBOM older than the code it describes.

protocol.title: Check the licences
protocol.text: Note components with no licence recorded, for the licence check.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: List the gaps, with the component, the problem and the fix. State whether the SBOM can be used for vulnerability matching.
